05.name: Engine Coolant Temperature (ECT)
05.whatIsIt: It is a thermistor (a resistor that changes its electrical resistance based on temperature) located in the engine block, cylinder head, or thermostat housing.
05.function: It measures the temperature of the coolant fluid refrigerating the engine and sends this data as a voltage signal to the ECU.
05.impact: The ECU uses this information as a primary parameter to calculate the required fuel injection (enriching the mixture when the engine is cold), adjust ignition timing, and engage the radiator cooling fans.

0C.name: Engine RPM
0C.whatIsIt: Signal generated by the crankshaft position sensor (CKP).
0C.function: Measures how many revolutions per minute the engine crankshaft is making.
0C.impact: Crucial for synchronizing fuel injection timing and ignition spark.
